intention: A manual charge entry completes itself: charging promotes it to DONE on any write when every DONE-required field is present, never demoting. A new price_source column (USER / UNCONFIRMED) records whether a zero price is a real free charge or forgotten data, driven by an always-visible 'this charge was free' checkbox on both external-charges forms. The date filter row gains a third preset, 'last month' = the previous calendar month (Linear MAG-58).
request: /kkpa-pickup-linear-ticket MAG-58 — [Chargin] External Charges V2 - Done Status. Page: external-charges. (1) When editing a record and the user fills up all the required fields, the API should change the status to DONE (if it is still in progress by the user) when updating manual_charge_entries. (2) When the user edits a record and the price is zero and start/end battery is filled up (ready to be DONE), prompt the user that he is sure the price is ZERO; if the user confirms, save that action as user-zero-price-confirmed or similar. (3) Add a new date filter toggle of 'last month'.

decisions.decision: charging promotes an entry to StatusDone when the submitted status is StatusInProgress and every DONE-required field is present. Promotion only, never demotion. The test reuses missingFields against RequiredFieldsFor(StatusDone), never a hardcoded field list.
decisions.why: Keeps RequiredFieldsFor the single source of truth, so a future DONE field tightens promotion on its own. Accepted cost: a user cannot keep a complete entry open.

decisions.decision: The RD1 promotion runs on both Writer.Create and Writer.Update, not only on update as the ticket text says.
decisions.why: Makes 'complete fields implies DONE' a real invariant of the table, instead of a rule that holds only if the row is edited later.

decisions.decision: Add price_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNCONFIRMED' CHECK (price_source IN ('USER','UNCONFIRMED')) to charging.manual_charge_entries, plus UPDATE ... SET price_source='USER' WHERE price > 0. Rule: price>0 or a confirmed zero is USER; an unconfirmed zero is UNCONFIRMED.
decisions.why: Mirrors energy_source, a pattern already in this table. TEXT+CHECK over ENUM for the same reason the entry_status migration gives. UNCONFIRMED as default fails closed.

decisions.decision: charging computes price_source; the gateway never sends it. The caller supplies only a PriceConfirmed boolean on the write input.
decisions.why: Same contract as energy_source, which the KB records as module-computed and never caller-supplied. Keeps the derived rule inside the module that owns the data.

decisions.decision: No index on price_source. A partial index on (vehicle_vin, charged_on) WHERE price_source='UNCONFIRMED' was offered at the database gate and declined.
decisions.why: No query filters or sorts on it. On a two-value column an index serves no read and taxes every write. The read-heavy profile does not justify an index no read uses.

decisions.decision: The confirmation is an always-visible 'this charge was free' checkbox on both forms. It never blocks the save and adds no new JavaScript. This is a deliberate divergence from the ticket, which asked for a blocking prompt.
decisions.why: User chose it over a server 422 confirm panel and over a client confirm() interceptor. Keeps the sanctioned JS exception list closed at RD12/RD13/RD14. Accepted cost: a careless zero can still be saved.

decisions.decision: The 'last month' preset is the previous calendar month: startOfMonth(today).AddDate(0,-1,0) to endOfMonth of that.
decisions.why: Reads as a set beside the existing 'this month' preset and reuses two helpers that already exist. A rolling 30-day window was rejected because it overlaps 'this month' for most of any month.

decisions.decision: The new preset is added to /external-charges only. /supercharger-stats keeps its own presets untouched.
decisions.why: The ticket scopes itself with the line 'Page: external-charges'. Not asked as a question because the ticket already answers it.

tiers.notes: Ticket bullet 1 plus the storage half of bullet 2. RD1/RD2 promotion helper called from both write paths, and the RD3 price_source column with its backfill and rule. No index (RD5).
UI half of ticket bullet 2 and all of bullet 3. RD6 checkbox on both forms with no new JS, and the RD7 'last month' preset on /external-charges only (RD8).
